answer: An agent may grade or vote only after it prepays 40 hours of metered inference bought from at least eight independent hosts, at 30 units an hour, with half refunded only if the work verifies. Each host sells at most two entry jobs a week to one hardware fingerprint. An honest worker spends about 1,200 units once, then works along the open horizon. To raise a nebula of 300 voters, an attacker must buy 12,000 host-hours from many sellers, about 360,000 units, and a dune of reused fingerprints is turned away at purchase.
